title: Promote query-trajectory future-root placement
premise: E79's typed 2x2x2 replay matrix produced one surviving algebraic contract: E77_MeshFacing_WorldVelocity plus QueryTrajectoryRootMotion. The current runtime already uses the E77 query contract but still builds PHC future targets from raw animation root motion, approximately 300 cm/s with no requested turn, while the authoritative shell/query contract is 160 cm/s with the scripted yaw progression.
single_change: Only while RuntimeState is LocomotionActiveShell, place each canonical sampled future animation pose on the corresponding authoritative query-trajectory root before BuildMimicTargetPoses. Preserve each body's transform relative to the sampled animation root. Standing continues to use the existing raw animation future targets.
locked_invariants: scripted-locomotion.v1.json and scripted-locomotion.v2.json remain byte-for-byte unchanged
Pose Search facing remains mesh-facing and query velocity remains authoritative world velocity
selected animation, shell movement, policy model, observation semantics, actions, gains, Physics Control targets, and terminal criteria do not change
the selected world-to-data frame remains ResolveMimicTargetReferenceDataFrame
no asset-name override or selection-policy override is introduced
no full product run occurs before focused deterministic tests and replay capture validation pass
tdd_red: A pure future-pose placement test references an unimplemented helper and asserts exact target roots, preserved body-local transforms, preserved times, and malformed-input rejection
A target-root schedule test asserts selected t=0 root identity, 160 cm/s progression, requested yaw sign/magnitude, exact zero preservation, and world-data round trip
A runtime-state gate test asserts placement only in LocomotionActiveShell
A replay-record validation test requires trajectory samples and both final policy tensors plus the policy action signature
acceptance: Every placed future root equals its query-derived target root within 1e-5 position and angular tolerance
Every non-root body's root-relative position and rotation are preserved

The deterministic replay artifact contains actor and mesh transforms, query trajectory samples, selected animation identity/time, selected world/data roots, physical and canonical body samples, raw and placed future samples, self observation, mimic target, and policy action signature
PhysAnim.Frames, PhysAnim.Adapter.ProtoManny, scripted locomotion runtime, and protocol-authority tests pass
Exactly one protocol-authoritative v2 Normal probe is executed after the focused gate passes
rejection: Any change to shell path, protocol hash, query velocity, Pose Search selected asset distribution, policy/action/gain semantics, or test cadence
Placed future speed differs from the query/shell contract by more than five percent
Requested turn sign or magnitude is lost
The authoritative probe fails terminal standing, support, readback, or protocol linkage
next_if_supported: Evaluate the single Normal probe. Do not run ZeroActions or tune controls until the replay proves E80 changed only future-root placement and the probe result is understood.
